comparison.objective: Unscrew capped Luer-lock needles from syringes and place them in a sharps tray or container without exposing a needle.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold each syringe against thread drag while rotating its capped needle, then withdraw and place the small part.
comparison.success_condition: All needles are unscrewed, withdrawn, capped, and contained; any pulled-off cap zeros the trial.
comparison.reason: Although both use bimanual reaction control during rotation, PR-1861 removes threaded parts safely rather than setting, jam-nut locking, and functionally cycling an adjustable stop.
